resume_elfsight_description: Elfsight develops a no-code website widget platform with 90+ products serving millions of users worldwide. Own the internal widget configuration framework, customer dashboard, and frontend tooling and infrastructure, including builds, CI, and workers.
resume_elfsight_timeline: Built and shipped the Timeline widget from scratch using React and TypeScript, with seven responsive layouts, SEO optimizations, gesture navigation, and synchronized editor previews.
resume_elfsight_performance: Reduced desktop demo load-to-preview time from approximately 6.1s to 3.9s by preloading dependencies, deferring non-critical code and analytics, and removing blocking translation requests.
resume_elfsight_i18n: Designed and rolled out shared internationalization across 90 widget products supporting 76 languages, using Lingui with tree-shaken translation catalogs, Nx migration tooling, and developer documentation.
resume_elfsight_builds: Accelerated local and CI widget builds approximately 2.5-3.5x by upgrading Vite 8/Rolldown, Storybook 10, and Lingui.
resume_elfsight_boundaries: Enforced module boundaries across 20+ packages in an Nx monorepo and introduced tooling to detect circular dependencies.
resume_elfsight_testing: Introduced automated visual regression testing for the shared configurator, migrated existing tests from Jest to Vitest, and added smoke coverage for 20+ widget products.
resume_elfsight_ai: Developed an AI prototyping agent and custom Storybook skills used by designers to build UI prototypes.
resume_code_it_up_description: Custom software development company delivering e-commerce and enterprise client projects. Owned frontend feature delivery from planning and technical design through production release.
resume_code_it_up_design_system: Built a design system and reusable React component library for a tax-monitoring application, providing a consistent foundation for UI development.
resume_code_it_up_marketplace: Developed marketplace purchasing features, including product filtering, navigation, discounts, and optimistic cart updates using Redux and Redux-Saga.
resume_code_it_up_tables: Built forms and virtualized data tables for a Next.js tax-monitoring administration panel, supporting workflows with large datasets.
resume_code_it_up_architecture: Designed frontend architecture, reviewed code, and onboarded a new developer, providing guidance on the codebase and feature implementation.
resume_lanbilling_description: Product company building billing and CRM software for telecommunications operators.
resume_lanbilling_payments: Integrated PSB payments into a telecom CRM, implementing frontend functionality and PHP backend API endpoints for the payment integration.
resume_lanbilling_components: Built reusable JavaScript UI components for internal applications and optimized frontend build configuration.
